title: Five minutes a day
message: Your job is decisions, not production — the Inbox shows what needs you, and the assistant does the rest, asking first
audience: Owners and marketers who don't have a content team

scenes.headline: Five minutes a *day.*
scenes.sub: What tending MeYouSocial Publisher actually looks like.
scenes.narration: Most days, running MeYouSocial Publisher is reading one email, or opening one page. The routine is a check, not a shift.
scenes.spoken: Most days, running Me You Social Publisher is reading one email, or opening one page. The routine is a check, not a shift.

scenes.headline: Silence means all *clear.*
scenes.narration: If something urgent is waiting, the workspace's admins get one morning digest email listing it, one link per item. A quiet morning sends nothing, on purpose. No email and a green Inbox means genuinely nothing to do.

callouts.label: Mornings
callouts.title: digest email, only on days that matter

callouts.text: No email and a green Inbox means genuinely nothing to do.

scenes.headline: Each card carries its own *button.*
scenes.narration: Work the Inbox top to bottom. Approve or request changes on a post. Answer a question in your own words; it is saved to the expert profile and asked once. Verify a claim with a real link, or drop it. Approve or replace a held image. The header count should reach zero.

callouts.label: Asked once
callouts.title: Answers are banked to the expert profile

scenes.headline: One hard deadline in the whole *app.*
scenes.narration: Answer people the day they write. Distribute, then Engage, holds comments, direct messages and reviews in one place. The one hard deadline in the whole app is here: Facebook and Instagram only accept a direct message reply within twenty-four hours.

callouts.label: Facebook · Instagram
callouts.title: window to reply to a DM

scenes.headline: Ask, instead of *hunting.*
scenes.narration: If you would rather not hunt, ask. The Ask button sits on every page. Say what should I do next, and the assistant reads the Inbox, the pipeline, the connections and the dials, ranks the moves, and offers to do each one.

callouts.label: Then
callouts.title: Ranks the moves and offers to do each one

scenes.headline: I'm about to. Go *ahead?*
scenes.narration: It can do nearly everything you can do here. Anything outward-facing or hard to undo is proposed first, as I am about to, go ahead? It runs only when you say yes. Every action lands in the audit log. And it will never enter API keys, delete a workspace, or send an email on its own.
scenes.spoken: It can do nearly everything you can do here. Anything outward-facing or hard to undo is proposed first, as: I am about to. Go ahead? It runs only when you say yes. Every action lands in the audit log. And it will never enter API keys, delete a workspace, or send an email on its own.

callouts.text: Never keys, never deletes, never sends email on its own.

scenes.narration: Five minutes a day. MeYouSocial Publisher. Your job is decisions, not production.
scenes.spoken: Five minutes a day. Me You Social Publisher. Your job is decisions, not production.
